title: Unbiased news aggregator
summary: News from all sides without bias.
whyTempting: Polarisation is a widely felt problem.
whyItFails: People prefer their bias. Demand is lower than stated. Publisher dependency. Content isn't yours. Monetisation. Ads and subscriptions are hard.

attempts.notes: News app that broke stories into short, neutral summaries.
AI-personalised news aggregator from Instagram's founders; closed because the market opportunity wasn't big enough.

reasons.detail: People prefer their bias: Demand is lower than stated.
Monetisation: Ads and subscriptions are hard.
